No living hand gave me the title, and I have never established who gave it to the woman before me, and you may take that as the shape of the whole business before we start on the details.

Sit down, supplicant. You came out of the water and you were not raised at it — the vowels are wrong, and I am four hundred years out of practice at hearing anything, so they must be very wrong indeed. That is not held against you here. It is only that you have been counted twice, once by the pool and once by an office, and I have spent my whole life on what becomes of a thing that is counted twice by two people who do not speak.
Ixtu-Meer. He has kept the Count since before the ninth recension and he has been waiting for a visitor to come down and ask him one honest question about it.

Sit down, supplicant. You are Chimer-get, and the word for your people has been changed twice while I have been at this desk, so you will forgive me if I reach for an old one. Whatever is between us is four centuries out of date. I am told the current version is a great deal worse than the one I remember, and I am not going to pretend to an opinion I have not earned. Put the blade down where I can see it and we will get on faster; it is not fear, it is arithmetic, and you will find that everything down here is.

delivers.the sill: Through the arch at the far end and down eleven steps. There is a cut stone across the bottom of the arch, about as high as your ankle, worn hollow in the middle where four thousand years of feet have gone over it. It is a step. Everyone who has gone over it has come back up, and I have never been able to establish whether that is because the room lets them or because none of them did anything, and I have had a long time to think about it and no way at all to test it.

delivers.the opening of the count: Before you ask me that you should go and hear the ones who will have to live in the answer. Back through the arch, along the gallery, and take the long lit way rather than the stair through the working parts — the eleven bays are all off it, there is a keeper in each of them, and not one will refuse you. It costs you a day and a half and you will not get it back, and I would spend it. Then ask me again, and I will tell you where I differ from them, and you will be able to hear that I am differing rather than deciding.
